decisions.Kwic: 且去咬嚼他一個顛撲不破的現成句子。咬嚼來、咬嚼去

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunxi Langting Ting (雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄): in his volume-four general address, Yunxi Langting Ting instructs beginning students to chew over an unbreakable ready-made sentence repeatedly until old masters' tongues can no longer deceive them.
